title: Starting Reading of a Replacement Fleet Unit under Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans
content:
**Rule.** For a Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan of the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans moved onto a replacement unit, the replacement unit's starting reading follows its own records. The replacement unit is the one delivered on the customer's single Kessler Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement standing in closed status in the Vehicle Purchase Agreements records.

| Replacement unit's records | Starting reading |
|---|---|
| It has a repair-order check-in (Service Accounts and Repair Orders records) | Its highest check-in odometer |
| No check-in, and it was delivered by home delivery | Odometer at delivery less the delivery distance in miles, never below 0 |
| No check-in, and it was delivered at the showroom | Odometer at delivery |

**Hypothetical illustrations.**
- Delivered by home delivery at an odometer of 260, with a delivery distance of 85 miles and no check-in: the starting reading is 175.
- Delivered by home delivery at an odometer of 40, with a distance of 65 miles: the result would be below 0, so the starting reading is 0.
- The same unit after one check-in at 2,410: the starting reading is 2,410, whatever the delivery method.
